data.name: Help_BasicsText
data.value: • Open: File > Open, or drag a PDF into the window • Drag with the Hand tool to pan; Ctrl+mouse wheel to zoom • Comment tab: add text, highlights, drawings, shapes, stamps and more • Edit tab: edit text, edit objects (move or delete images and shapes), add text, images and shapes • Pages tab or the thumbnails on the left: insert, delete, rotate, reorder and extract pages • Snapshot on the Home tab: copies the dragged area as a picture; a single click copies the whole page • Save with Ctrl+S; undo/redo with Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y

data.name: Help_ShortcutsText
data.value: Ctrl+O Open · Ctrl+S Save · Ctrl+Shift+S Save As · Ctrl+P Print Ctrl+Z Undo · Ctrl+Y Redo · Ctrl+F Find · F3 Find next Ctrl+1 Actual size · Ctrl+2 Fit width · Ctrl+0 Fit page · Ctrl+L or F11 Full screen Esc: cancel the current action · Delete: delete the selected object or annotation
